original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the sole identity and clothing reference: an already approved original fictional adult 3D character. Produce ONE new front-facing eye-level ID portrait of THIS EXACT SAME CHARACTER. Preserve precise facial identity, eye shape and color, nose, lips, jaw, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, ears, accessories, costume and premium Chinese otome semi-realistic 3D CG rendering. Do not redesign or beautify into a different person. Camera directly in front at eye height: zero yaw, pitch and roll, upright head, both eyes level and looking directly forward, symmetric frontal shoulders. Calm neutral closed mouth. Composition: exactly 1024x1536 pixels, portrait 2:3, clean head-and-shoulders ID photograph framing, crop around upper chest below clavicles. Entire hairstyle plus any hat, crown, animal ears or ornaments must be completely inside canvas, with about 8 percent blank space above the topmost point. Center the face on the vertical axis. Face from brow to chin should have a consistent apparent scale throughout the series; enlarge framing only as necessary to fit unusually tall ornaments. No hands in frame. Background completely solid pure white #FFFFFF with no gray gradient, vignette, scenery or props. Bright neutral soft frontal studio lighting and gentle balanced fill, clear unobstructed facial features, high detail hair and fabric, smooth luminous skin with subtle texture, dimensional refined CG, not live-action photo. No text, number, logo, watermark, border, collage, additional views or additional subjects. Only change camera angle, framing and neutral expression as needed; retain the approved character's identity and design.
